role: Living renderer for the ghast: picks the normal or shooting texture from attackCounter and scales the ModelGhast by the attack-progress falloff before the model draws.

members.name: ghastTextures, ghastShootingTextures
members.note: static constants, grouped; the TEX_GHAST and TEX_GHAST_SHOOTING entries

members.name: getEntityTexture
members.note: the kind-to-texture switch picks TEX_GHAST_SHOOTING when e->ghast_shooting (EntityGhast.func_110182_bF)

members.name: preRenderCallback
members.note: the MOB_GHAST branch scales by 1/(attack_progress^5*2+1); play.c interpolates m.attack_progress

notes: The ghast model itself (ModelGhast) is model_ghast; the doRender flow is RendererLivingEntity's, mapped in RendererLivingEntity.java.json.
